portal_hypertension.title: Incidence, associated factors and prognostic association of acute kidney injury after TIPS: a multicenter retrospective study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Shang J, Cheng P, Cao H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究（样本量约为 995）。核心观点：本研究调查了经颈静脉肝内门体分流术 (TIPS) 后急性肾损伤 (AKI) 的发生率、危险因素和预后影响。 临床提示：这项多中心回顾性研究纳入了在中国三家医院接受 TIPS 的患者。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This study investigated the incidence, risk factors, and prognostic implications of acute kidney injury (AKI) after transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS). This multicenter retrospective study included patients who underwent TIPS at three hospitals in China. AKI risk factors were identified using multivariate logistic regression in the overall cohort. Propensity score matching was performed to balance baseline covariates. Survival differences were assessed using the Kaplan-Meier method, and the association between AKI and mortality was evaluated using stratified Cox regression models. A total of 995 patients were included, of whom 4.92% developed postoperative AKI. Multivariabl...

portal_hypertension.title: Seladelpar in patients with primary biliary cholangitis and compensated cirrhosis: Efficacy and safety from RESPONSE and ASSURE studies.
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Randomized Controlled Trial / Clinical Trial, Phase III
portal_hypertension.authors: Gordon SC, Villamil A, Jacobson IM
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床试验。核心观点：原发性胆汁性胆管炎 (PBC) 和肝硬化患者的治疗选择有限。 临床提示：Seladelpar 是一种首创的 delpar（选择性 PPAR-δ 激动剂），在 3 期 RESPONSE 研究中，对代偿性肝硬化患者与非代偿性肝硬化患者的疗效和安全性大致相似。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Treatment options are limited for patients with primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) and cirrhosis. Seladelpar, a first-in-class delpar (selective PPAR-δ agonist), had generally similar efficacy and safety among patients with versus without compensated cirrhosis in the phase 3 RESPONSE study. Here we provide additional data on seladelpar in patients with compensated cirrhosis from the phase 3 program. In RESPONSE, patients with PBC and an inadequate response or intolerance to UDCA were randomized 2:1 to seladelpar 10 mg or placebo for 1 year. portal_hypertension.title: Characteristics of Pancreatic Cancer-associated Ascites and Redefined Criteria for Bacterial Peritonitis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Yeo M, Cho IR, Lee SH
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于多中心临床研究。核心观点：本研究旨在调查 PDAC 相关腹水的特征，并提出重新定义 PDAC 患者细菌性腹膜炎的诊断标准。 临床提示：探索队列中 PDAC 相关腹水的病因（腹膜癌病、门静脉高压或混合病因）和特征......
portal_hypertension.abstract: The diagnosis of spontaneous bacterial peritonitis relies on polymorphonuclear (PMN) cell counts (>250/mm 3 ) in cirrhotic ascites. However, ascites in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) develop through mixed mechanisms, presenting different profiles compared with those of cirrhotic ascites. This study aimed to investigate the characteristics of PDAC-associated ascites and propose redefined criteria for bacterial peritonitis diagnosis in patients with PDAC. This retrospective study was conducted at 3 tertiary medical centers in Korea. portal_hypertension.title: Asialoglycoprotein receptor-bound PLGA nanoparticles loaded with Riociguat targetedly ameliorate portal hypertension in liver cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hsu SJ, Hsu YC, Yen PL
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：尽管血管扩张药物和/或经颈静脉肝内门体分流术已在临床上广泛用于治疗门静脉高压症，但它们通常不太令人满意，因为这些方法可能会极大地影响整个病情。 临床提示：虽然血管扩张药物和/或经颈静脉肝内门体分流术在临床上已广泛用于治疗门静脉高压症，但由于这些方法通常不太令人满意。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension typically arises with liver cirrhosis and often leads to life-threatening side effects that complicate treatment. Although administrations of vasodilation drugs and/or transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt have been widely used to treat portal hypertension in the clinic, they are usually less satisfactory because those methods may dramatically influence the entire cardiovascular system rather than the liver alone, indicating that an effective and safe approach for reducing cirrhotic portal hypertension is still strongly demanded nowadays.
